ios.title: iPhone and iPad
steps: Open Hitta Lyan in Safari and tap the Share button (the square with the arrow).
Open Hitta Lyan from the home screen, go to Account and tap “Enable notifications”.
ios.note: Requires iOS 16.4 or later. Notifications only work in the home-screen version, not in regular Safari. Not getting notifications? Settings → Notifications → Hitta Lyan.

android.title: Android
steps: Open Hitta Lyan in Chrome, Edge, Samsung Internet or Firefox.
Go to Account and tap “Enable notifications”, allow when the phone asks.
Optional: add to the home screen via the browser menu for quicker access.
android.note: Not getting notifications? Check Settings → Apps → your browser → Notifications, and that battery saver is not restricting the browser.

desktop.title: Desktop
steps: Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari (macOS 13 or later) are supported.
Go to Account and click “Enable notifications”, allow in the browser prompt.
Notifications also appear when the tab is closed, as long as the browser is running.
desktop.note: On Mac: System Settings → Notifications → your browser must be allowed. On Windows: Settings → System → Notifications.

about.title: About Hitta Lyan
about.lead: A tracking service for people in a Swedish housing queue.

what.title: What the service does
what.body: Hitta Lyan keeps an eye on new rental apartments at Bostadsförmedlingen i Stockholm, Boplats Väst, Boplats Syd and Uppsala bostadsförmedling. You save a filter for what you are looking for, and get an email and a notification the moment a listing matches. You choose which queue you belong to and see one at a time.

why.title: Why it exists
why.body: The agencies' own sites are built for you to search yourself, whenever you happen to think of it. Attractive apartments are often listed for only a few days, and it is easy to miss one simply because you looked on the wrong day. The idea behind Hitta Lyan is simple: you should not have to keep checking manually.

how.title: How it works
how.body: Every thirty minutes we fetch the current listings from the agencies, compare them against your watches and get in touch when something new matches. We also show an estimate of your odds, based on the agencies' own statistics on how much queue time similar homes have required.

independent.title: Independent of the agencies
independent.body: Hitta Lyan is not run by, and has no connection to, any of the housing agencies. We do not let any homes and we do not accept applications. All applications are made at the agency, using your ordinary account there.

money.title: How the service is funded
money.body: Browsing listings, filtering and using the map is free. Watches with email and push, and the ability to save favourites, are part of Pro, which is a paid subscription. We do not sell your data to anyone.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.lead: In short: what you can and cannot expect from this service.
disclaimer.updated: If you have questions about any of this, you are welcome to contact us.

source.title: The data comes from others
source.body: All listings and their details are fetched from the housing agencies' own websites. We do not create any content ourselves and cannot change what a listing says. What the agency shows always takes precedence over what is shown here.

accuracy.title: We cannot guarantee accuracy
accuracy.body: We fetch fresh data every thirty minutes, but a listing may have changed, been removed or been given new terms since then. Details can also be misread when we parse them. Always check with the agency before making a decision.

noAffiliation.title: No affiliation with the agencies
noAffiliation.body: Hitta Lyan is an independent service with no connection to Bostadsförmedlingen i Stockholm AB, Boplats Göteborg AB, Boplats Syd AB or Uppsala bostadsförmedling. Their names are used only to describe where the data comes from.

noApplication.title: We do not let any homes
noApplication.body: You cannot apply for an apartment through Hitta Lyan. You apply at the agency using your account there, and it is their queue rules and terms that decide who gets the home.

chance.title: The odds meter is an estimate
chance.body: The assessment is based on the agencies' own statistics on previously let homes, and on the queue date you entered yourself. It says something about how your queue time compares to others, but it is not a prediction. The underlying data also differs between cities: Stockholm reports quartiles, Boplats Väst an area average, and Boplats Syd and Uppsala no queue-time statistics at all.

queueTime.title: You enter your queue time yourself
queueTime.body: None of the agencies offer a login that would let us fetch your queue time automatically. The date you enter under Account is used only to work out your queue time and show your odds. If the date is wrong, so is the assessment.

availability.title: The service may be unavailable
availability.body: We cannot promise that the service always works or that every notification arrives. The agencies' websites can change or go down, and data may then be missing or out of date. Do not rely on us alone if a particular home matters to you.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: The service is provided as is. We are not liable for homes you missed, for decisions you made based on information here, or for damage arising from the service being unavailable or showing something incorrect.
